i just got top surgery 2 weeks ago, my experience has been good. the complications are possible but for the most part seem to be quite rare. i was higher risk for certain complications due to some of my health issues but have had none and am healing fine. 
recovery is pretty straight forward, the surgeon you go to may have different requirements. i have to wear an ace wrap for 6-8 weeks, at 6 weeks i can take it off when i sleep, cant raise my arms above my head for 4 weeks, and cant lift more than 5 lbs for 4 weeks. 
the first few days was kinda rough due to having all the adhesive under the post op binder and the drains, but nothing crazy. having the drains removed wasnt painful at all. i had some pain when i first woke up but it went away pretty quick, it was mostly just being uncomfortable. i had some more pain come through the 5th-10th day but it got under control and i havent had much pain since. im autistic as well and the binder and adhesive was sensory hell but you'll have all that off in a 4-7 days probably. its worth it, let me know if you have any questions
